title: Review as Code Finding
description: Optional machine-readable projection of a RaC finding file, derived per SPEC Section 16.1. Markdown remains the canonical human-readable format. Additional properties are permitted so repositories MAY extend the record.

id.description: The finding's local ID, e.g. F001. The canonical globally unique ID R###-F### is derived from the review directory and this value (SPEC Section 7).

state.description: The derived, materialised finding condition (SPEC Section 8.5). Lifecycle logs remain authoritative.

decision.description: Recommended values from SPEC Section 8.2. Repositories MAY use other values.

implementation.description: Recommended values from SPEC Section 8.3. Repositories MAY use other values.

verification.description: Recommended values from SPEC Section 8.4. Repositories MAY use other values.

id.description: The entry's stable local identifier, e.g. D001, I001, or V001.

value.description: The lifecycle value recorded by the entry, e.g. accepted, implemented, or verified.

actor.description: The role or identity of the entry author.
